semver: MINOR: a new Performance path-tracing preset and fire-thawed snow are backward-compatible features; save/load now keeps NPC actions with an optional save row that older saves omit. Saves/settings remain compatible; campaign protocol 23 and Autochess protocol 5 are unchanged.

headless_catalog.scope: Every headless program in tools/parity/gameplay_catalog.json from private source (remake regressions, no original-executable comparison). Each program that did not pass was rerun on 1.36.0 source (private a5722f5fe) and fails identically there, with the same failure lines: none is introduced by 1.37.0.

packaged_linux.scope: Every focused case (headless and rendered, GPU Lab) against the 1.37.0 Linux package. 13 not-passed cases were rerun against the published 1.36.1 Linux package and fail identically; the other 12 are language/resolution or zone variants of those cases. RR/DLSS cases need native Windows/D3D12 and are covered under Proton.

windows_proton.scope: Packaged 1.37.0 Windows build, D3D12 under GE-Proton 11-11 / VKD3D in GPU Lab, one locked prefix: window extents, PT programs, Ray Reconstruction raw/resources/presentation/live, RR fast travel day/night, RTXDI, transmission, preset options, Performance mode and tactical camera.
windows_proton.note: path_trace_performance_mode failed once (grove colour balance 0.0505: the Balanced capture caught the sky still changing, ground-only tint 0.011); the immediate rerun passed all 144 checks (grove 0.0013). Frame generation was not exercised.

tooling.script_parse: 1257 scripts, 0 failed (1 needs the patched engine)

linux-x86_64.scope: 383 of 408 packaged cases pass in GPU Lab; every other case fails identically on 1.36.1.

windows-x86_64.scope: 13 packaged D3D12 cases under Proton; native Windows not run.

macos-universal.scope: Package built and script-audited; engine unchanged from 1.36.x.

android.scope: APK built, signed with the public certificate and audited; no device run.

web.scope: Fresh Chromium start and upgrade from published 1.36.1 cache; IndexedDB retained.

limits: Native Windows GPU, macOS and Android device runs were not performed.
Frame generation was not tested for this release.
27 headless catalog programs and 25 packaged cases fail identically on 1.36.0/1.36.1; they are pre-existing and listed above.
Path tracing and frame generation remain experimental.
